daily.topThemeTitle: Classrooms Keep Moving Ahead of Policy
daily.topThemeBody: While the funding and governance layers argue, teachers are shipping: an Alabama library rebuilt as a STEM innovation hub, educator-built AI tools, ESL experiments. Practice is setting the precedent that policy will later have to codify.

heroWeek.themeBody: The recurring K-12 and campus IT message is that data governance, observability and an AI bill of materials come before the AI deployment, not after it. Districts collecting everything still can't say what their data means.
